# Documentation

Project documentation lives here. Each doc uses YAML frontmatter for
title, description, and keywords -- the `scripts/update-docs-index.py`
script reads that frontmatter and regenerates this index automatically.

Open a linked file when you need it; docs are meant to be read on demand,
not all at once.

## Adding a new doc

1. Create `docs/NN_topic-name.md` with frontmatter:

```yaml
---
title: "Topic Name"
description: "One-line summary of what this doc covers."
keywords: [keyword1, keyword2, keyword3]
order: 10
---
```

2. Run `scripts/update-docs-index.py` to regenerate this index.

Filenames prefixed with `_` (e.g. `_draft-thing.md`) are ignored by the
index script -- useful for drafts and work-in-progress.
